headline: Protesters in D.C. rally for priorities to counter Trump’s 250th anniversary programming
summary: Activists gathered in Washington D.C. on June 27th to protest Trump administration policies and advocate for various social causes such as stricter gun laws, higher minimum wage, voting rights for convicted felons, and Palestinian statehood. The event, Next250, counter-protested the Freedom 250 celebrations happening simultaneously.
